# archipelago-hotels-mcp

> Go MCP server for searching and recommending Archipelago Hotels & Resorts properties across Indonesia and Southeast Asia.

A Sentec Tech product that exposes four MCP tools backed by a central MySQL catalog and eight per-brand databases, fetches live room rates from the SimpleBooking XML API with a stored-rate fallback, and renders an interactive hotel dashboard as an embedded MCP App resource. Supports 279+ hotels across 13 brands via stdio (Claude Desktop) and Streamable HTTP on :9011.

## Key Facts

- Transport: stdio (Claude Desktop, Pi Agent) | Streamable HTTP :9011
- Tools: search_hotels, recommend_hotel, find_hotels, get_hotel_detail (app-only)
- Database: MySQL — central db_archipelagowebsite + 8 lazy-connect per-brand DBs
- UI: MCP Apps embedded Vite+TypeScript hotel dashboard (ui://hotel-dashboard)
- Rate sources: SimpleBooking XML API (live, circuit breaker, 5-min cache) → stored tb_hrooms.room_rate → hotel_starting_price
- Brands: Aston, Grand Aston, The Alana, Harper, Hotel NEO, favehotels, Kamuela, Quest, Huxley, Nordic, Four Corners, PBA
- Language: Go 1.25, github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk v1.6.1, Gin v1.11.0
